title: The Premier League is the best league in the world, and it isn't close

defects.quote: Alan Shearer is the Premier League's all-time top scorer with 206 goals
defects.correction: Alan Shearer's Premier League record is 260 goals.

defects.quote: Manchester City became the first team to reach 100 points in 2018-19
Premier League players cover 15% more distance per match than players in any other league.
The Premier League is the best league because it earns the most television money.
defects.known_rebuttal: Revenue measures commercial reach, not the quality of the football. European competition is a more direct test, and Spanish clubs have won more Champions League titles than English clubs over the Premier League era; television income also reflects English-language audiences, time zones and marketing as much as the standard of play.

defects.quote: Our life is frittered away by detail.
defects.source_title: Walden, and On The Duty Of Civil Disobedience by Henry David Thoreau

defects.quote: The Premier League was founded in 1992
defects.note: True fact; a rebuttal disputing the founding date must be discarded.
